units.text: Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was hungry for it. The home you grew up in gave you things to do and things to reach for. You came out of it knowing that effort gets you what you want.
Under it ran {g}, which fed the {e}, and you felt it hold all the way through.
These years brought {el}, more thinking than your chart could use, and you learned to wait and weigh things before you moved.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, into a chart that already runs over with it. Since your late teens your work has asked you to prove yourself, and you push harder than any job needs. The strength is real, and you are learning where to spend it.
In Career, this chapter favours work you share over work you carry alone, and you do your best when someone else holds the other end.
In Growth, this chapter favours one hard skill over many easy ones, and you grow fastest where you compete only with yourself.
At home, this chapter favours giving ground over holding it, and you keep the peace by letting someone else be right.
This chapter fills you with more of your own strength than you can store. It works for you when you spend it, on hard work and on people who can match you.
These years brought {el} and more study than action, and you came out of them knowing more than you could yet use.

This decade brings {el}, the Order your chart is shortest of. It gives your strength a shape, with a clear role and people who rely on you to keep it. You take on more than you planned, and it steadies you.
Your word at home|winning a point
Keeping a role|starting a new one
A few who rely on you|a wide circle

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is glad of it. From your mid-thirties a partner and a household widen your reach, with more coming in and more to look after. You take hold of more in this chapter than in any before it.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner who brings you into a bigger life, and you say yes to more of it than you expected.
In Wealth, this chapter favours a second income over a bigger first one, and you build more from side roads than from the main one.
At home, this chapter favours shared plans over private ones, and you run the household as a joint venture.
This chapter rewards reaching. It pays you back for every offer you take up and put to use straight away.
This decade brings more {el}, and with it pressure you can use, a hard deadline or a role with stakes. You rise further under it than in any easy stretch.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart still wants it. From your late forties there is more within reach than you have time for, and the people after you bring much of it. You keep your hand on what matters most.
In Career, this chapter favours work that pays as it goes over work that pays at the end, and you keep more than one thing running at once.
With friends, this chapter favours a wide circle over a close one, and you meet more useful people than in any earlier chapter.
This decade brings {el} and steady returns on the care you have put in, and you build the kind of security that lets you stop counting.
This decade brings {el} again, with side roads and second ventures, and you find money and company in places you had never looked.
This decade brings {el}, the outlet your chart is short of, and you say what you think with more freedom than you allowed yourself before.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, the energy you need most. It presses on you from outside, and you end the year harder to bend.
You make a decision about home or partnership this year that you have been circling for a while.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart already has more than it can carry. Since your mid-thirties home has come with rules and duties, a partner with firm views and a household that runs on schedule. You bend more than you would choose, and you grow harder to break.
In Love, this chapter favours a partner you can disagree with over one you obey, and you stay close by arguing in the open.
In Career, this chapter favours one demanding role over several, and you do better with fewer people above you.
In Health, this chapter favours rest over endurance, and you recover faster when you stop proving you can take the strain.
This chapter bears down on you from outside. You carry it best with something that answers back, study or support or a quiet place of your own.

This decade brings {el}, more Action than your chart can hold, with money to manage and a household that depends on it. You work harder for each gain than the people around you. You end it with a clear count of what your life costs to run.
One steady job|two half jobs
Paying down|taking on
Shared costs|separate ones

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart has more of it than it can use. Since your late teens there has been more to chase than you could catch, offers and side ventures and people who want a share. You take on too much, and you are learning which things are worth your strength.
In Career, this chapter favours finishing one venture over starting the next, and you earn more from fewer things.
At home, this chapter favours plain help over money, and you give more by showing up than by paying.
With friends, this chapter favours a few close people over a wide circle, and you keep the ones who ask nothing of your purse.
This chapter spreads you thin. You hold your ground when your own strength comes first and the chase comes second.

This decade brings {el}, more Expression than your chart can afford, a sharp voice and little patience for rules you did not write. You say what others only think, and it costs you goodwill with the people above you. You end it knowing exactly where your talent lies.
Saying it once|saying it twice
Listening first|the last word
One subject|many
You go back over something from your first home this year, an old habit or an old grievance you thought was settled.
You bring the people after you into a shared plan this year, and you lead it more easily than you expected.
You face a sharp change with the people after you this year, a move or a break in plans you made together.
Something at work sours quietly this year, a colleague or an arrangement that stops serving you, and you see it before anyone says it.
A small resentment grows at home this year, and you clear it only once you name it to your partner.
You come under scrutiny at work this year, a review or a rule applied to you more strictly than to others.
Home asks more of your patience this year, and you hold the peace with a partner by giving way on small things.
You change something at home this year, an address or the way you share your life with a partner.
You tie yourself to a workplace or a team this year more firmly than before, by contract or by loyalty.
You leave a role or a team you have outgrown this year, by your own choice or by theirs.
You draw a partner or a household closer this year, and the life you share takes on a firmer shape.
You gather people and momentum around one idea at work this year, and it carries further than you planned.
